doc_text: Aurora is a premium lifestyle brand targeting design-conscious adults aged 28 to 45. Tone of voice is warm confident and understated. Spring and summer campaigns should lead with sustainability credentials and natural imagery. Primary markets are Germany and the wider EU. Avoid aggressive discounting language as it dilutes the premium positioning.

Demand for Aurora products skews heavily to short-form video on TikTok and YouTube among the under-35 audience. Conversion campaigns in summer should weight budget toward social and video. Awareness campaigns perform best with programmatic display in the German market.

Nimbus is a value challenger brand for budget-aware families. Tone is friendly direct and practical. Always-on search is the backbone of Nimbus performance marketing. Loyalty and retention messaging should emphasise everyday savings. Key markets are the UK and France.

Vertex is a global premium technology brand undergoing a brand relaunch in 2026. Tone is bold visionary and precise. Relaunch campaigns must maintain consistent visual identity across all markets and lead with innovation narrative. Primary market for the relaunch is the United States.

Any campaign with a total media budget above five million euro requires senior governance sign-off before launch. Briefs for such campaigns must explicitly state the budget and flag the governance requirement.
